card.title: SUSTAINED PRESSURE
card.text: Deal damage to a unit equal to kredits spent operating this turn.
card.flavorText: During WWII, Stalingrad was a major Soviet industrial city on the Volga, with factories, rail links, fuel stores, and river traffic that supported the front. In August 1942, Luftflotte 4, one of the primary divisions of the German Luftwaffe  concentrated much of its strength there as German ground forces closed on the city. Fliegerkorps VIII was ordered to support the 6th Army and 4th Panzer Army, which saw Stalingrad as central to the wider German drive toward the Caucasus oilfields. On 23 August, German aircraft carried out one of the heaviest air attacks yet seen on the Eastern Front. Ju 87 dive bombers, Fw 190 ground attack aircraft, He 111s, and Ju 88s struck Soviet positions and then the city itself. Around 1,600 sorties were flown that day, dropping about 1,000 tons of bombs. Fires spread through factories, schools, homes, oil tanks, and docks, while smoke rose high above the Volga. The pressure did not end with the first raid. Stalingrad was bombed block by block for days, and Luftflotte 4 kept flying repeated missions against Soviet troops, airfields, river crossings, and industrial districts through the battle.
